name: Elk Bivouac
tagline: Where great teams go to become inevitable.
positioning: The offsite platform for founders and small teams who treat a week in the wild as strategy, not vacation. We handle every logistic between idea and altitude.

hero.h1: Book the mountain. We'll handle the mission.
hero.sub: Elk Bivouac turns a scattered group chat into a fully planned offsite — venue, agenda, meals, and the one conversation your team keeps avoiding. You just show up and lead.

features.title: The Ridge Brief
features.description: A single living document that captures the offsite's objective, agenda, and non-negotiables — no more twelve-tab spreadsheets the night before departure.

features.title: Venue Reconnaissance
features.description: We vet cabins, lodges, and off-grid basecamps against your headcount, budget, and connectivity needs, then hold the booking before it sells out.

features.title: Agenda Architecture
features.description: Hour-by-hour flow built for real outcomes: deep work blocks, forced friction sessions, and enough silence for people to actually think.

features.title: Provisions Handled
features.description: Dietary needs, ground transport, and the coffee that decides morale — coordinated end to end so nobody plays travel agent from a tent.

features.title: Momentum Ledger
features.description: Every decision and owner captured live, then exported as a follow-up plan that survives the drive home instead of dissolving in it.

features.title: Basecamp Signal
features.description: Real-time updates, weather shifts, and headcount changes routed to one channel so the whole party moves as a single organism.

testimonials.quote: We spent three years talking about a proper offsite. Elk Bivouac had us at a fire pit in the Cascades in eleven days, and we came home with a roadmap the whole team actually believes in.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vane

testimonials.quote: I run a two-person company and I have never felt more like a real organization than the morning I opened the Ridge Brief and realized every last detail was already handled.
testimonials.name: Devin Achterberg

testimonials.quote: The Momentum Ledger is the only offsite tool I've used where the decisions outlived the flight home. Six months later we're still executing against it.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar
